newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest hogs Monday seen steady-up $1-private.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest hogs Monday seen steady-up $1-private.

text.p: Midwest cash hog prices Monday were seen steady to $1.00 per cwt higher amid expected light hog marketings, livestock dealers said.
Top prices on hogs delivered to the plant in Iowa and southern Minnesota were expected to range from $54.00 to $54.50, with Illinois buyers expecting tops there of $54.00 to $55.00 at plants.
Indiana buyers said they expect top prices to match Friday's at $51.50 to $52.00. Ohio top hog prices at the plant were expected to range from $53.00 to $53.50.
Hog prices Friday were lifted by strong demand from packers looking to put together a large Saturday slaughter to offset lost production from Monday's Labor Day holiday, market sources said.
USDA estimated Saturday slaughter at 160,000 head, compared with 23,000 a week ago and 221,000 a year ago.
